variance_axes.observational_statistical: Variance/covariance supplied by the observational data product or likelihood.
variance_axes.observational_systematic: Calibration, selection, foreground, scale-cut, nuisance or covariance-model uncertainty.
variance_axes.sample_calibration: Shift induced by changing named samples/calibrations while holding the scientific question fixed.
variance_axes.optimizer_multiseed: Spread across optimizer starts/seeds; a numerical-stability diagnostic, not posterior uncertainty.
variance_axes.prior_boundary: Sensitivity to prior ranges or fitted parameters landing on a declared bound.
variance_axes.identifiability_support: Whether fitted parameters are constrained inside the redshift/scale support actually observed.
variance_axes.provenance: Uncertainty caused by missing hashes, release identifiers, licenses, ordering or source semantics.

pantheon_plus.interpretation: RLL is numerically nested/LCDM-like in this SN-only likelihood; transition parameters are not identified by observed support.

des_dovekie.interpretation: CPL maximum lies on the wa lower bound; RLL is nested/LCDM-like and its transition lies outside SN support.
